prompt: Implement relativeTime(date, now) in time.js (both are Date objects). Rules: under 60 seconds either way -> "just now"; under an hour -> "N minutes ago" or "in N minutes" ("1 minute ago" for one); under a day -> hours the same way; between 1 and 2 days in the past -> "yesterday", in the future -> "tomorrow"; under 7 days -> "N days ago" / "in N days"; otherwise the date as YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Round down. Export it as a named export.
